evals.prompt: A search job was preempted after writing some designs and oracle refolds. Resume the campaign without losing completed work.
evals.expected_output: A reconciled campaign ledger preserving completed designs, refolds, immutable events, and scheduler settings, with missing or failed outputs recorded and remaining work resumed through a linked retry run.
assertions: Reconciles artifacts and records missing or failed outputs explicitly
Creates a linked retry run instead of overwriting the interrupted run

evals.prompt: Show exactly why design d17 is a passer and where it came from.
evals.expected_output: An evidence-backed audit of design d17 tracing its annotated input, resolved configuration, run, parent lineage, criteria-set version, actual metric values, and exact oracle predictions.
assertions: Traces the design to its annotated CIF, resolved config, run, and parent lineage
Reports the named criteria-set version and actual metric values
Links oracle-derived values to exact oracle predictions
Does not infer provenance from filenames
